definitions.short: Bigthan or Bigthana , a eunuch of Xerxes
definitions.full: H904. Bigthan or Bigthana בִּגְתָן proper name, masculine (Persian bagadâna , gift of God ?) a eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 2:21 = בִּגְתָנָא 6:2 . בִּגְתָ֫נָא see foregoing.
